developer.match: Match each piece of software to the company or person behind it.

rows.label: ChatGPT
rows.description: artificial intelligence chatbot developed by OpenAI
rows.hook: is an AI assistant that answers questions and writes essays from typed prompts

rows.label: Gmail
rows.description: email service developed by Google
rows.hook: is a free inbox service that wowed users by offering a huge storage allowance and fast search

rows.label: Android
rows.description: operating system created by Google for use on mobile devices
rows.hook: is the world's most widely used phone operating system, named after a humanoid robot

rows.label: macOS
rows.description: operating system for Apple computers
rows.hook: is the desktop system powering iMac and MacBook computers, once known as OS X

rows.label: Windows 11
rows.description: personal computer operating system by Microsoft released in 2021
rows.hook: is a desktop operating system known for its centered taskbar and rounded corners

rows.label: iOS
rows.description: mobile operating system by Apple Inc.
rows.hook: is the software that runs the iPhone and iPad

rows.label: Windows XP
rows.description: personal computer operating system developed by Microsoft
rows.hook: was a hugely popular desktop system known for its green Start button and rolling-hills wallpaper

rows.label: App Store
rows.description: digital app distribution platform for iOS/iPadOS
rows.hook: is where iPhone owners download games and programs

rows.label: Safari
rows.description: web browser developed by Apple
rows.hook: is the default web browser on iPhones and Macs, with a compass icon

rows.label: Ubuntu
rows.description: Linux distribution developed by Canonical
rows.hook: is a popular free Linux system named after a southern African philosophy of shared humanity

rows.label: Messenger
rows.description: instant messaging app developed by Meta Platforms
rows.hook: is a chat service tied to the world's biggest social network, with a blue bubble logo

rows.label: Windows 7
rows.description: personal computer operating system by Microsoft that was released in 2009
rows.hook: was a desktop system widely seen as a fix for its unloved predecessor, with a glassy Aero look

rows.label: Scratch
rows.description: programming language learning environment
rows.hook: is a block-based coding tool where kids snap colorful pieces together, with a cat mascot

rows.label: LibreOffice
rows.description: free and open-source productivity software suite by The Document Foundation

rows.label: MS-DOS
rows.description: Microsoft operating system
rows.hook: was a text-only command-line system that ran early IBM-compatible PCs

rows.label: LaTeX
rows.description: document markup language

rows.label: Windows Vista
rows.description: personal computer operating system by Microsoft that was released in 2007
rows.hook: was a desktop system criticized for slow performance and constant permission pop-ups

rows.label: Threads
rows.description: social networking site operated by Meta Platforms
rows.hook: is a text-based social network launched as a rival to the bird-logo site once called Twitter

rows.label: iTunes
rows.description: media player and library software
rows.hook: was the music player and shop that sold songs for 99 cents and synced iPods

rows.label: Windows 95
rows.description: personal computer operating system by Microsoft
rows.hook: introduced the Start button and taskbar to millions of desktops

rows.label: OpenOffice.org
rows.description: discontinued free software ofice suite

rows.label: Internet Explorer
rows.description: discontinued web browser by Microsoft
rows.hook: was the blue-e browser once installed on nearly every PC before being retired after long ridicule

rows.label: Vim
rows.description: text editor, improved version of Vi

rows.label: MediaWiki
rows.description: free and open-source wiki software, developed by the Wikimedia Foundation

rows.label: Kotlin
rows.description: general-purpose programming language derived from Java

rows.label: AutoCAD
rows.description: commercial computer-aided design (CAD) and drafting software application
